[short] skip
[!compiler:gc] skip '-weave instruments via the gc compiler'

# -weave instruments memory accesses in the built packages, but must not shadow
# a user-supplied -gcflags: the command-line package must be compiled with both
# -weave (forced) and the user's -N.
go build -n -weave -gcflags=-N .
stderr 'compile.* -weave .*main\.go'
stderr 'compile.* -N .*main\.go'

# -weave instruments only the command-line package, not its dependencies:
# instrumenting sync/runtime internals would turn their private memory operations
# into scheduling points and break DPOR's transition reduction. Force a full
# rebuild so dependencies are recompiled and check that the command-line package
# gets -weave while the sync dependency does not.
go build -a -n -weave .
stderr 'compile.* -p main .* -weave'
! stderr 'compile.* -p sync .* -weave'

# -weave defines the "weave" build tag.
go list -weave -f '{{.GoFiles}}' .
stdout 'weave_only.go'

-- go.mod --
module m

go 1.25

-- main.go --
package main

import "sync"

func main() {
	var mu sync.Mutex
	mu.Lock()
	x := 0
	_ = x
	mu.Unlock()
}

-- weave_only.go --
//go:build weave

package main

var underWeave = true
